text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "No way...! How could this happen...?!"

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
"Unbelievable...! First-year newcomer 
Maruzensky, in her very first appearance! 
She's single-handedly overwhelmed all 
seven opponents! In an unprecedented feat, 
she's won the championship in just fifteen 
minutes!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Oh dear, all the upperclassmen came after 
me all at once, you know? 
Does this mean... it's like, my total and 
perrr-fect victory...?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"A-Amazing. It wasn't even a contest. 
Well, everyone knew she was gonna win 
anyway... Ahaha."

text_block_list.name: Spectator Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wait. Is this year's finals 
seriously over already?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "O-Oh dear...? Uhhh..."

text_block_list.name: Finalist Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Guhhh...! There's no way we could win 
against that...! 
B-But... this is a competition...! What a 
bitter defeat...!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"N-No way...! It was only because 
Maruzen-san was too strong...!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"I see... Because of what happened back 
then, Maruzen-san never participated even 
once after that..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"(That hesitation when I invited her... 
wasn't my imagination after all. 
She was definitely... holding back for the 
sake of the other participants...)"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Still... that's just so... 
Maruzen-san..."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Watermelon, check! Swim ring, check! 
Wooden fish temple drum, check! Kemari 
ball, cheeeeeck! 
Now I gotta buy snacks and bananas! Whew~ 
talk about busy!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Ooh! Look at the good stuff they got 
here! 
With this and the kemari ball, we can play 
Heian-era baseball! Gonna be spending it 
in pure elegance♪"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Please, lend me your strength!! 
I wanna make delicious condensed milk 
shaved ice for everyone!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Hm-hmm, hm-hmm, hm-hm-hmmm♪ 
...Oh, McQueen! How's your trip prep 
coming along?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"That massive pile of luggage... You went 
and bought unnecessary junk again, didn't 
you? 
Honestly, you've been fooling around for 
days on end... *sigh*"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah? You should be foolin' around too, 
y'know! 
What's with the sighing, huh...?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You said you'd go all out since you're 
entering, didn't ya?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"I fully intend to take the events 
seriously. However, I have no desire to 
fool around and cause trouble for those 
around me."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Y-You're going on a trip for fun, but you 
ain't gonna have fun...?! What are you 
even saying?! 
That makes as much sense as a 
whole-grilled fish with no body! What 
kinda grill even is that?!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...Tsk. Please leave me alone. 
It is none of your concern."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"...Ghk! Golshi-chan was—Golshi-chan was 
planning on playing together with you 
until we dropped, and..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
N-No matter what kind of face you make, it 
will not work!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"No no no, play with meee! Let's do 
single-player cat's cradle together~! 
Aloe fishing is fun too, y'know~! Let's go 
hug a giant squid togetherrr!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Good grief! I care not for any of that! 
Put an end to your selfishness this 
instantーーー!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Hold it right theeeere! Just shut up and 
play with meeee!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Nakayama-san! My apologies for 
causing such a commotion..."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Tell me about it, sheesh... 
Well, I can pretty much guess what you're 
bickering about, though."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Nakayama! You tell 'er something 
too! 
All she ever talks about is boring crap 
like 'trouble for others' and 
'annoyance'!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As I said, you are the one being utterly 
selfish!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Heh... If you ask me, neither of you is 
in the right."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Times like this, why not make a 'bet'? 
That'll settle things once and for all."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Settle it with a bet...? 
I see. It is true that we are getting 
nowhere like this."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Sounds fun. We got the perfect event 
coming up, anyway. 
How about we settle it in the finals?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"A fine opportunity. I have long thought 
your absurdly selfish antics have gotten 
entirely out of hand..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Gold Ship-san. If I win, you will promise 
to behave yourself for a while!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Fine by me, you're on! But if I win, 
we're dancing beach ballet all night long! 
And you're the prima ballerina!"

text_block_list.name: McQueen & Golshi
text_block_list.text: Gh...ーーーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh, things are finally starting to 
heat up around here...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"...Ufufu, everyone seems so busy getting 
ready for the trip♪ 
Golshi-chan especially, with that enormous 
load of luggage!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Chiyo-chan seems to be practicing hard, 
too... 
Everyone's looking forward to it so, so 
much..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
—Yes, I'm looking forward to it. Very much 
so...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, Chiyo-chan? 
...Yahoo! What a coincidence! Did you come 
out to catch the breeze too?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"No, I was actually looking for you, 
Maruzen-san. 
There's something I wanted to talk about."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"The truth is... I watched the video of 
the past finals. 
The one from the year you won..."
